name: Bioengineering PhD (joint program with the University of Oregon)
summary: Joint Oregon State and University of Oregon PhD in bioengineering. You do not need an advisor before applying; funded students are matched with one on admission. December 1 is the published deadline.
detailsNote: The December 1 deadline is published without a year, so it is not confirmed for Fall 2027. The pages opened do not state a GRE policy for the PhD, and say the program does not guarantee funding for every admitted student.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application deadline (as published)
publishedDeadlines.note: The application page says applications for the joint OSU-UO PhD and MS must be received by December 1 for matriculation the following fall; the program page calls it the final deadline. No year is given; confirm Fall 2027 directly.

timeline.decisions: Application decisions begin in February and continue through spring.

english.note: For applicants whose first language is not English or who are international: TOEFL iBT 88 or IELTS Academic 7.0 overall. Waived with a bachelor's degree or higher from a regionally accredited US institution or an English-speaking institution in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand or the UK (or Ghana or Nigeria for native English speakers). Certificates of English as the language of instruction are not accepted.

applicationFee.note: The application page lists $75 for domestic and $85 for international students; non-refundable. The program page says it does not provide application fee waivers.

documents: Transcripts from every institution attended (unofficial or official accepted at application)
requirements.note: Applicants enter the names and emails of three recommenders; they submit letters online. All applicants are reviewed by at least two faculty members, and meeting minimum requirements does not guarantee admission.

funding.note: There is no separate funding application. Funding is prioritized for PhD applicants, but applicants may be admitted without a funding offer. Assistantships are appointed term by term, and funding offers are accepted by April 15.
